SUBSTITUTE TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT
NARRATIVE
2346 West Taylor Street

The Applicant seeks to rezone 2346 West Taylor Street from a B3-2 Community Shopping District
to a B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District in order to legalize two (2) existing dwelling units for
a total density of 8 dwelling units. The subject property is currently improved with a three-story
multifamily residential building with 8 total dwelling units. The Applicant is simply seeking to
bring the property to a compliant zoning district to legalize the existing density. No commercial
space or parking will be provided.
